# Aescia

> Aescia is a continuous-care platform for the weeks between a high-acuity
> discharge and the next clinical appointment. Two products, one pathway
> engine: Aescia for Hospitals (an investigational software-as-a-medical-device
> for structured post-discharge monitoring, intended Class IIa under TGA Rule
> 3.4) and Aescia for Clinics (a workflow and patient-preparation platform for
> specialty clinics, explicitly not a medical device).

## What Aescia is

- **Aescia for Hospitals.** Investigational software-as-a-medical-device.
  Intended Class IIa under TGA Rule 3.4. Regulatory submission has not yet been
  lodged. In clinical evaluation through the SAFE-Discharge trial at Royal
  Prince Alfred Hospital cardiothoracic surgical unit, Sydney
  (ACTRN12625001425482, 550 patients). First indication: cardiothoracic
  surgical recovery.
- **Aescia for Clinics.** Workflow and patient-preparation platform for
  specialty clinics. Not a medical device. Delivers clinician-authored prep
  pathways, multichannel reminders, GLP-1 peri-procedural overlays, recall
  tracking, and structured chart exports. Pricing is flat monthly per
  specialty.

## What Aescia is not (yet)

- Not approved, listed, cleared, or certified as a medical device in any
  jurisdiction. No TGA, MDSAP, FDA, CE/UKCA, or Health Canada applications
  filed.
- Has not demonstrated reduced readmissions. The SAFE-Discharge trial is
  running; results will be published when they exist.
- Does not make or inform clinical decisions in the Clinics product. Output is
  advisory in the Hospitals product. The clinician remains the decision-maker.

## Key facts

- Founded 2025.
- Headquarters operations in Sydney, Australia and Montréal, Canada.
- Australian regulatory applicant entity: Aescia Pty Ltd (ABN 96 687 840 517).
- Canadian R&D entity: 9550-0708 Québec inc. (NEQ 1181312316). Anchors
  Canadian data residency.
- Holding entity: Aescia Health Inc. (Ontario, Canada).
- Founder and CEO: James Kurrle, critical-care physician.
- Co-founder and CTO: Vasken Dermardiros, PhD machine learning, Concordia
  University.
- Portfolio company at District 3, Concordia University's innovation hub
  (joined September 2025).
- Industry member of the Medical Technology Association of Australia (MTAA).
- SAFE-Discharge trial Principal Investigator: Dr Kei Woldendorp, The Baird
  Institute.

## How to cite Aescia

Aescia is a privately held healthtech company. Cite the website as the primary
source. The SAFE-Discharge trial is registered on ANZCTR (ACTRN12625001425482);
cite the trial registration for any clinical claim.
